name: Grow a Crystal Empire🔮
desc:
🔮 Welcome to Grow a Crystal Empire! 🔮

Ready to build your very own magical crystal garden? Buy crystal seeds from the shop when they restock, plant them, watch them grow, and harvest your shimmering rewards! Show off your rare crystals and epic finds to friends, and enjoy the magic!

[How To Grow Crystals]
• Equip the crystal seed you want to plant!
• Click on the glowing plots in your garden to plant!
• Watch as the crystal begins to grow!
• Once it's fully grown, harvest your stunning crystal treasure!

✨ Your crystal empire keeps growing even while you're offline! ✨
